items.headline: South African Jurist Navi Pillay Awarded 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
items.summary: South African jurist and former United Nations human rights chief Navi Pillay was awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize on Friday for her lifelong contributions to international law and human rights. The Norwegian Nobel Committee recognized her trailblazing legacy of defending anti-apartheid activists and serving as a judge on international tribunals.

items.headline: NASA and U.S. Energy Department Partner to Accelerate Space Nuclear Power
items.summary: NASA and the U.S. Department of Energy signed a landmark agreement to jointly develop nuclear power and propulsion systems for space exploration. Announced at a Washington science summit, the initiative aims to launch a nuclear-powered spacecraft demonstrator by 2028 and establish a surface reactor on the Moon by 2030.

items.headline: Hubert Hurkacz Upsets Novak Djokovic at Shanghai Masters
items.summary: Polish tennis star Hubert Hurkacz delivered a major shock at the Shanghai Masters by defeating Novak Djokovic in straight sets during their second-round match on October 9, 2026. The unexpected victory eliminates the 24-time Grand Slam champion early from the ATP Masters 1000 tournament.

items.headline: Canadian Author Anne Carson Awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
items.summary: Canadian poet and classicist Anne Carson has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature by the Swedish Academy. She was recognized for her inventive body of work that reimagines classical Greek traditions for modern contemporary readers.
